components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-primary { font: 700 16px "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; min-height:44px; border:1px solid #315b47; border-radius:.65rem; padding:.55rem 1rem; background:#315b47; color:white; } .ds-primary:hover { background:#234535; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #985b28; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-primary:active { background:#39241e; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-secondary { font:700 16px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; min-height:44px; border:1px solid #315b47; border-radius:.65rem; padding:.55rem 1rem; background:#fffdfa; color:#593b30; } .ds-secondary:hover { background:#eee2d6; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #985b28; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Text field
components.css: .ds-label { font:700 16px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; color:#302c29; } .ds-field { display:block; min-height:44px; border:1px solid #9e8a7b; border-radius:.5rem; background:#fffdfa; padding:.5rem; font:inherit; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #985b28; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Filter chip

narrative.overview: A calm shared workspace with the warmth of a daily journal and the clarity of a task app. Paper-like surfaces and a quiet serif heading give the app a human character; familiar controls and compact list rows keep attention on the work.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutrals and restrained status colors.
Serif headings paired with readable sans-serif controls and task text.
A date-led header and a shared list grouped by deadline, with clear filters and direct status selection.
Mobile-first spacing, visible focus, and honest synchronization feedback.
dos: Do keep actions familiar, labeled, and usable with keyboard and touch.
Do show authoritative save and synchronization feedback in Spanish.
Do allow long task titles and deadlines to wrap.
donts: Don't rely on color alone to convey status or errors.
Don't introduce decorative paper textures that compete with the task list.
